{{Quote|General Garza recruited them into the Special Forces black ops program, but now they're in a detention facility on Berrun&mdash;convicted of war crimes.|Sergeant Rusk|<ref name="The Surgeons" />}}
A '''detention center''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Berrun]] was operated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Run by a [[Unidentified Berrun warden|warden]], the compound was used to [[Prison/Legends|incarcerate]] the members of the [[Surgeons]]&mdash;a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] in the [[Republic Special Forces Division]]'s [[Special Forces black ops program|black ops program]]&mdash;after they were convicted of war crimes and given life sentences. [[Karsim]], [[Naja]], and [[Eckerd]] were among the members of the squad, and the warden informed their former commanding [[Officer/Legends|officer]], [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]], that the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was proud of the fact that they had targeted the families of the enemy leaders they were supposed to be eliminating.<ref name="The Surgeons" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Berrun prison was first mentioned during the conversation "The Surgeons" with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] companion character Fideltin Rusk, in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="The Surgeons" />
